name: The night between
when: the turn: after the Landing and lesson five, the tip with Ellis (by the end of week five at the latest)

steps.verb: arrested on the entry; custody in hours; through the wall, Ron has offered a statement, to be signed at nine; bailed that evening

keys.how: sign first: walk back in and put the line on paper under his own name (Ron walks; Frank charged, on bail to the end, the licence suspended a fortnight, a post lost)

a cheaper way, only if his record earned it: the brief (Agar's man, at the brief's fee) argues Ron out as a messenger, or DC Wardell loses the statement (200 pounds, once; Ellis notices); Ron allows either only if Frank came for him at the gate or redeemed Mickey's watch
let it stand: at nine Ron signs, and goes in on remand to the end

steps.words: Saying's nowt, boss. You've a firm to stand in. I've a door.
lines: Saying's nowt, boss. You've a firm to stand in. I've a door.

pay.note: Wardell's price 200 pounds once (economy); the brief's fee (economy)

returns: Act III's charge or Ron's absence
src: STORY-FRAME 5 The night between (decision of 24 Nov: Ron goes inside unless Frank pays to stop it); RT2-05 (if Ron is gone, the most loyal man stands in)
